titleZh: AI 商业心智：2027 年怎么用 AI 赚钱
speaker: Dan Martell
role: Author of Buy Back Your Time · Martell Ventures
sourceLabel: If You Want To Make Money With AI In 2027 — Dan Martell

blocks.en: 1. It is not the tools
blocks.zh: 1. 关键不在工具，在于你怎么解读信息和排优先级

blocks.en: Whiteboard title: AI Business Mindset.
blocks.zh: 白板标题：AI 商业心智（AI Business Mindset）。

blocks.en: People think it's the tools, they think it's the models, they think it's the AI, but it's actually the way you're interpreting the information and prioritizing it that's going to make it a game changer for you or not.
blocks.zh: 大家总以为关键在于工具、模型或 AI 本身，但真正决定它能不能帮你破局的，是你怎么解读信息、怎么排优先级。

blocks.en: There's a lot of people out there that use AI and they use it the wrong way, and they will not grow or make money because of it.
blocks.zh: 现在用 AI 的人很多，但用错了方向，结果公司既长不大，也赚不到钱。

blocks.en: 2. AI = dumb shit faster
blocks.zh: 2. 第一条：AI 只是把蠢事做得更快

blocks.alt: Writing point 1: AI = Dumb Shit Faster.
blocks.en: Point 1 on the board: AI = Dumb Shit Faster.
blocks.zh: 白板第一条：AI = 把蠢事做得更快（AI = Dumb Shit Faster）。

blocks.en: One of the first beliefs and philosophies I have to share with you — number one out of five — is that most people use AI to do dumb shit faster.
blocks.zh: 我要分享的五条核心理念里，第一条就是：大多数人用 AI，只是把蠢事做得更快。

blocks.en: And that is not the way we win. We don't do the wrong thing faster, we do the right thing.
blocks.zh: 靠这个是赢不了的。我们不是要把错的事做得更快，而是要先做对的事。

blocks.en: And to do that, you need to understand what a constraint is. Every business at any point in time only has one primary constraint.
blocks.zh: 要做到这一点，你得先理解什么是「瓶颈」。任何一家公司在任何一个时间点，都只有一个核心瓶颈。

blocks.en: If you identify it using AI, then you can surge your whole team on solving that problem.
blocks.zh: 如果你先用 AI 把这个核心瓶颈找出来，就能集中整个团队的火力，一起把这一个问题彻底打穿。

blocks.en: That mindset is a shift, because most people — I teach them some of these powerful AI technologies — and they just keep doing the wrong thing faster. And their business doesn't grow, and their gross margins don't grow.
blocks.zh: 这是一次思维转换。我教过很多人非常强大的 AI 技术，但他们还是拿着新工具把错的事做得更快——结果公司既没有增长，毛利率也没提高。

blocks.en: 3. You + AI > team + AI
blocks.zh: 3. 第二条：你 + AI，比团队 + AI 更重要

blocks.en: Point 2: You + AI > Team + AI.
blocks.zh: 白板第二条：你 + AI > 团队 + AI。

blocks.en: The second big mindset shift is you plus AI over your team plus AI.
blocks.zh: 第二个重大的思维转变是：「你 + AI」的优先级，高于「团队 + AI」。

blocks.en: I know you want your team to grow, but your team adoption is a byproduct of your adoption.
blocks.zh: 我知道你希望团队能成长起来，但团队用不用 AI，其实是你自己用不用的副产品。

blocks.en: I've coached many incredible business owners doing 10 million, 25 million, 50 million on the advanced ways to use AI — to extract large amounts of demand, automate sales and processes and delivery so they can create profit — and they still default to their team.
blocks.zh: 我辅导过很多年营收一千万、两千五百万甚至五千万美元的优秀老板，教他们用高阶 AI 方法挖掘大量需求，把销售、流程和交付自动化来创造利润——可他们还是习惯性地直接把事丢给团队去学。

blocks.en: When I tell them: your team is following your lead. You are the bottleneck, not your team.
blocks.zh: 我会直接告诉他们：团队是跟着你的节奏走的。真正的瓶颈是你，不是你的团队。

blocks.en: So I encourage you to create space in your calendar to dedicate to your learning, to your growth, to you becoming that person for your team. Big theme, big principle. Don't let it go unnoticed.
blocks.zh: 所以我建议你在日程表里专门留出时间，投入到自己的学习和成长上，先让自己成为团队可以效仿的那个人。这是一条大原则，千万别忽略。

blocks.en: 4. Role engineering over prompt engineering
blocks.zh: 4. 第三条：角色工程，胜过提示词工程

blocks.alt: Point 3 on the board: Role Eng > Prompt Eng.
blocks.en: Point 3: Role Eng > Prompt Eng.
blocks.zh: 白板第三条：角色工程 > 提示词工程（Role Eng > Prompt Eng）。

blocks.en: Number three, the big shift in the mindset of AI, is role engineering over prompt engineering.
blocks.zh: 第三个重大的 AI 思维转变是：「角色工程」比「提示词工程」更重要。

blocks.en: The whole world of AI shifted, I believe, when the agents started getting hosted by some of these large models — like Grok Bot, like ChatGPT Dots, like Claude Duet that just came out and is not readily available for most people. And we're seeing this with Muse and Instinct.
blocks.zh: 我觉得整个 AI 世界发生质变的节点，是大模型厂商开始直接托管 Agent——比如 Grok Bot、ChatGPT Dots，还有刚发布、大多数人还用不上的 Claude Duet，Muse 和 Instinct 也都在走这条路。

blocks.en: When people go, hey Dan, how do I get my AI to do smarter things? I go: who would you want to hire next to give you the most bandwidth in your business — what role?
blocks.zh: 经常有人问我：「Dan，怎么才能让我的 AI 干出更聪明的事？」我会反问他：「为了给你的业务腾出最大精力，你下一个最想招的人是谁？那是一个什么角色？」

blocks.en: Then I ask them to define what that person would do. As they're defining it to me, if they pulled out their phone and talked to their Grok Bot, their Claude Duet, their ChatGPT Dots, they would learn quickly that all they're doing is defining the role, not the prompts, for the AI to execute on their behalf.
blocks.zh: 接着我会让他们把那个岗位要干的活说清楚。只要他们一边梳理，一边拿出手机跟 Grok Bot、Claude Duet 或 ChatGPT Dots 对话，很快就会发现：自己其实是在为 AI 定义「角色」，而不是在写「提示词」，好让 AI 替自己执行工作。

blocks.en: That is a massive mind shift that most people out there — the amateurs — will never get results from, because they're still stuck here. They're still stuck in February 2026, which is not long ago, but that's how much it's changed.
blocks.zh: 这是一次巨大的思维跨越。外面大多数业余玩家之所以拿不到结果，就是因为思维还停留在写提示词的阶段——还卡在 2026 年 2 月。虽然那才没过去多久，但行业变化已经这么大了。

blocks.en: As you think about your rollout around the mindset of AI, please consider that your responsibility today as a CEO, a business owner, is to get better at role definition of your agents. You got to get good at defining it.
blocks.zh: 当你在公司里推进 AI 落地时，请记住：今天你作为 CEO 或企业主的核心职责，就是把 Agent 的角色定义能力练到炉火纯青。你必须学会怎么把角色定义清楚。

blocks.en: The reason a lot of you struggle with scaling your companies: you can't define the roles that would come into your business to help you unblock your number one constraint.
blocks.zh: 很多人之所以很难把公司规模化，正是因为他们定义不出：到底该引入哪些角色，才能帮自己打通眼下的第一瓶颈。

blocks.en: 5. Data equity
blocks.zh: 5. 第四条：数据资产

blocks.alt: Point 4 on the board: Data Equity.
blocks.en: Point 4: Data Equity.
blocks.zh: 白板第四条：数据资产（Data Equity）。

blocks.en: The next one is this concept I call data equity. Equity in the world of AI comes down to the quality of your data.
blocks.zh: 下一条是我称为「数据资产（Data Equity）」的概念。在 AI 时代，企业真正值钱的核心资产，归根结底取决于你的数据质量。

blocks.en: Access to the same models and the same tools that everybody else has doesn't give you an advantage. Where is the opportunity? The opportunity is in you cleaning up and verifying the data so you can feed these models, so they can take an idea all the way to a completed goal without a person involved.
blocks.zh: 大家都用着一样的模型、一样的工具，这根本给不了你任何优势。真正的机会在哪里？在于你把内部数据清洗干净、核验准确，再喂给模型——这样它就能把一个想法一路推进到最终目标，全程不需要人工介入。

blocks.en: A friend the other day asked me how he manages his whole sales process: before they even get on a call there's an intake form, then a sales conversation, then they sign an agreement, then they onboard them, then they put them in the system. I said, well, do you have examples of those steps? And he's like, no.
blocks.zh: 前几天有个朋友问我该怎么用 AI 管理整条销售流程：客户还没打电话前要填初筛表，接着是销售沟通、签协议、客户接入，最后录入系统。我问他：「这些环节你有整理好的优质样本吗？」他说没有。

blocks.en: The problem is: if you don't have the data defined and cleaned up, and you don't have examples you can give it so it can use its heat-seeking missile of execution, then you don't have value — which is the equity part.
blocks.zh: 问题就出在这里：如果数据没有定义清楚、没有清洗干净，也没有好样本可以喂给 AI，它再强的精准执行力也发挥不出来。这样你就沉淀不出真正的价值——这就是「数据资产」这一层的含义。

blocks.en: Every business needs to start asking: how do I create data equity inside my business? Because that's what's going to make you valuable to a potential buyer. That's what's going to make the AI actually get the work done for you.
blocks.zh: 每家公司现在都该开始思考：我如何在公司内部打造出「数据资产」？这不仅会让你在潜在买家眼里更有价值，更是让 AI 真正替你把活干完的前提。

blocks.en: 6. Learning loops
blocks.zh: 6. 第五条：学习闭环

blocks.alt: Complete board with Learning Loops circled and a Feedback loop drawn to the right.
blocks.en: Point 5, circled: Learning Loops, with a Feedback cycle drawn beside it.
blocks.zh: 完整白板：第五条「学习闭环（Learning Loops）」被圈了出来，旁边画着一个反馈（Feedback）循环。

blocks.en: The last one, and definitely not the least, is learning loops.
blocks.zh: 最后一条，同样至关重要：学习闭环。

blocks.en: People tell me all the time, Dan, I got bots, I got bots. I said, no you don't. You have automation. You don't have a bot and you don't have an agent unless you have a learning loop.
blocks.zh: 老有人跟我炫耀：「Dan，我搭了一堆机器人，我有好多 bot。」我会说：「不，你没有。你有的只是自动化流程。没有学习闭环，你就既没有真正的机器人，也没有真正的 Agent。」

blocks.en: A learning loop is a process where you define an outcome, it generates the results, and at one point there is feedback. That feedback is fed back into the initial prompt, and then it executes the steps in the process with that new knowledge, so that it gets better and better and better.
blocks.zh: 所谓学习闭环，就是先定义好目标结果，让 AI 产出内容，然后在流程中设置一个反馈节点；把人工反馈重新喂回最初的指令里，让它带着新经验把流程再跑一遍，从而一次比一次做得更好。

blocks.en: So if you have any agents or bots in your company and your team is not giving it feedback on its work, then you don't truly have an ability to get better over time.
blocks.zh: 所以，哪怕你公司里已经部署了 Agent 或自动化工具，只要团队没有持续给它的产出做反馈，这套系统就不具备随时间进化的能力。

blocks.en: That is how the best companies are scaling with AI: by understanding that an agent is not an agent without a learning loop, and creating the process.
blocks.zh: 那些最擅长用 AI 扩张的公司，秘诀就在于看透了这一点：没有学习闭环就不算真正的 Agent，并把这套反馈机制扎实落地到日常流程里。

blocks.en: A simple example: have your agent do some kind of analysis, post it into Slack, ask your team for feedback on the analysis, and tell your agent to monitor those posts, take the feedback, and treat it as opportunities to upgrade its brain, its rules, its steps, its process, its quality.
blocks.zh: 举个简单的例子：让 Agent 做完一份分析后直接发到 Slack，请团队在下面点评反馈；同时让 Agent 持续监控这些评论，把每一条反馈都当成升级自己认知、规则、步骤、流程和产出质量的机会。

blocks.en: If your team is looking at the output, giving it the feedback, and you're feeding that to the agent every week — 52 times a year — it can get better and better and better. That also informs your data equity. Do you see how these all stack on top of each other?
blocks.zh: 只要团队持续审阅产出、给出反馈，而你每周都把这些反馈喂回给 Agent——一年迭代 52 次——它就会变得越来越强。同时，这个过程也在反哺你的数据资产。看出来了吗？这五条其实是层层叠加的。

blocks.en: 7. They stack — and 2027 is the separator
blocks.zh: 7. 五条层层叠加，2027 年将是分水岭

blocks.en: When we know that AI today is still allowing most business owners to do the wrong thing or the dumb thing faster; that we have to develop our skills and understanding of this over our team, because our team can never outgrow our ability — we are the leaders, or the lids; that we need to get better at defining the roles of our agents; that we have to understand the data side — is it good, do we have great examples, do we know what a win looks like, do we know what success looks like; and then build those learning loops into our processes — that is how we make a lot of money.
blocks.zh: 当你看清了这整套逻辑：今天的 AI 依然在让大多数老板把错事、蠢事做得更快；我们必须把自己的 AI 认知和技能练到团队前面，因为团队永远无法超越领导者的上限——我们既是领路人，也是天花板；我们要把 Agent 的角色定义练好；要把数据这一关打牢——数据够不够干净、有没有优质样本、清不清楚什么是赢、什么是成功；再把学习闭环嵌进业务流程里——这就是用 AI 赚大钱的方法。

blocks.alt: Recap at the complete board: 2027 as the separator.
blocks.en: The five points stacked. 2027 is the separator.
blocks.zh: 五条理念叠加完成。2027 年将成为分水岭。

blocks.en: That's how you win. And it is no longer optional. 2027 will be the separator between the companies that decide to go pro and the amateurs that eventually go out of business.
blocks.zh: 这就是赢的方法，而且现在已经不再是可选项了。2027 年将成为一道分水岭，把决心走向专业化的公司，和最终被淘汰的业余玩家彻底分开。

blocks.en: When we think about every company now becoming an AI software company — it's not SaaS, it's not software as a service, it's your service as a software.
blocks.zh: 放眼未来，每家公司都会变成一家 AI 软件公司——不再是传统的 SaaS（软件即服务），而是「把你的服务变成软件」。

blocks.en: It's the problem you solve for the market. Get really good at that messaging, and then on the back end use this to deliver at a higher rate, at a higher quality, so that you increase your gross margin because you don't have to hire a bunch of people.
blocks.zh: 先把你在市场上解决的核心问题和价值主张讲透；后端再用这套 AI 体系，以更高的速度和质量完成交付。这样你不需要招一大堆人，毛利率自然就拉上去了。

blocks.en: You keep the people doing the people stuff, you use the AI to do the computer stuff, and all of a sudden you make a lot of money.
blocks.zh: 让人专注做适合人做的事，让 AI 去处理适合计算机干的活，利润很快就会源源不断地涌进来。

blocks.en: 8. Scale Workbook
blocks.zh: 8. 片尾：《Scale Workbook》增长手册

blocks.alt: Dan Martell sitting with the Scale Your Business Workbook cover.
blocks.en: Close: Scale Your Business Workbook.
blocks.zh: 片尾：Dan Martell 展示《Scale Your Business Workbook》手册封面。

blocks.en: Real quick, you've made it to the end. Let me tell you what I know about you. You're not somebody that's looking to do shelf help. You're not somebody that's just doom scrolling on social media. You're here because you want to build a real business, and you're sick and tired of not getting the real insights to grow inside your business.
blocks.zh: 先别急着走，既然你看到这里，我就知道你是什么样的人：你不是那种买完书就扔书架上吃灰的人，也不是整天在社交媒体上刷焦虑的人。你留下来，是因为你真的想把一家公司做扎实，而且早就受够了在业务增长上总是拿不到真干货。

blocks.en: So I want to help you avoid all the pain of figuring this out the hard way like I did. That's why I put together everything I've ever learned into the Scale Workbook. It's the internal document I use with every founder I work with that turns a chaotic business into a money-making machine, teaching you all of this without burning more hours. It's totally free. The link is in the description, or you can scan the QR code on the screen, because I'm here to help you build your empire.
blocks.zh: 所以我想帮你避开我当年摸着石头过河的弯路。我把毕生学到的经验都整理进了这本《Scale Workbook》——这是我辅导每一位创始人时都在用的内部手册，能帮你把一团乱的生意改造成赚钱机器，同时不用再拿自己的时间硬熬。手册完全免费，链接就在视频简介里，也可以直接扫屏幕上的二维码。我就在这里，帮你建立自己的商业帝国。
